route_contract: Input accepts exact Japanese 文章を構成して: / ： and ASCII-case-insensitive text-compose: headers; one newline is mandatory and every JSON body byte after it is retained.

MeaningIR records a typed ComposeText intent and the full original request span; Core invokes only document::compose_explicit_text, persists its typed artifact and passes the exact composed text to content/render/history.

Strict duplicate-key-rejecting JSON root fields are exactly materials, units, order and max_chars. Material fields are exactly id and text. Unit fields are exactly id, kind, fragments, with, required and protected. Fragment fields are exactly material, start and end.

All fragments are caller-selected half-open UTF-8 byte ranges within decoded material text. Fragment text is copied exactly in request order. A heading, paragraph, bullet, numbered line, quote, condition or caveat receives only the fixed formatting associated with its declared role.
Explicit order is primary. Companion units are included immediately after each parent; required units plus all condition/caveat roles are retained. Unselected optional units are explicitly listed.

Every output byte is continuously mapped to either an exact decoded material byte range and its containing JSON string token, or a unit directive that introduced a fixed layout token. The artifact includes original body/output SHA-256, unit output ranges, selected/omitted units and guarantee boundary.

The output guarantee describes caller-selected source fragments and fixed layout only. It does not certify truth, purpose fit, meaning equivalence, style, arbitrary composition or facts not directly supplied.

Malformed schemas, duplicate IDs/keys, unknown references, invalid UTF-8 boundaries, resource overflow and max_chars overflow produce typed stops without truncating content. No external reads/writes/sends are part of these observed requests.

resource_envelope.max_chars: 1..=100000 Unicode scalar values, includes separators and prefixes
resource_envelope.json_depth_and_nodes: strict shared parser limits: depth 64 and 32768 nodes
